common.subtitle: A simulated world for testing before building
common.disclaimer: Educational simulation. Simplified models. Not medical advice.

lobby.hero_desc: Choose an interactive district to conduct stateful laboratory experiments, test scientific hypotheses, and receive algorithmic feedback.
lobby.guided_desc: Guided Mode: Strict protocol compliance, safety rules, and algorithmic scorecards enabled.
lobby.free_desc: Free Play Mode: Sandbox exploration. Experiment freely without strict exam scoring gates.
lobby.storage_mode_demo: ⚠️ Demo storage: scores are not saved
lobby.mode_instruction: Choose a district below, then select Start (Exam) or Practice (Sandbox) in the briefing.
lobby.market_desc: High-frequency limit order books, automated market maker curves, and liquidity dynamics.
lobby.order_book_goal: Simulate adverse selection, bid-ask spread expansion, and token bonding curves.

districts.pharma_desc: Investigate absorption, distribution, metabolism, elimination, and concentration-response curves.
districts.pk_ward_goal: Administer oral paracetamol, sample plasma, and compute elimination half-life.
districts.dose_lab_goal: Multi-compartment PK/PD dynamics across oral/IV routes and patient covariates.
districts.chem_desc: Aqueous equilibrium, volumetric glassware titration, and pH indicator shifts.
districts.titration_goal: Standardize burette, pipette analyte, and drop-wise neutralize to find equivalence point.
districts.space_desc: Orbital mechanics, two-stage Tsiolkovsky delta-v, and Hohmann coplanar transfers.
districts.launch_goal: Calculate staging mass ratio, ignite ascent to LEO, and execute circularization burns.

hud.what_to_do: What would you like to do?

rules.r1_reason: Protects student researcher from chemical splashes and contact dermatitis.
rules.r2_reason: Ensures container weight is not erroneously added to the active drug dose.

settings.title: ⚙️ Laboratory Settings
settings.high_contrast_desc: Enforce pure black background and elevated contrast ratios (7:1+)
settings.tutorial_desc: Replay the 90-second keyboard and camera walkthrough

state.offline_banner: ⚠️ Offline – working locally where possible, cloud features paused.
state.webgl_desc: Your browser or device does not support hardware-accelerated WebGL. You can still play the 2D pharmacokinetics simulation game:

error.title: ⚠️ Simulation Error
error.default_what_happened: The laboratory encountered an unexpected simulation error or network timeout.
error.action_reload: Check your network connection and reload the laboratory session.
error.action_lobby: Return to the main lobby and select another experiment.

onboarding.title: 🎮 Laboratory Controls Walkthrough
onboarding.step1_desc: Use WASD or the Arrow Keys to walk around the laboratory. Press Shift to sprint.
onboarding.step2_desc: Hold right-click and drag to rotate the camera. Press C to toggle Follow/Free camera, V for 1st-person, and R to re-center.
onboarding.step3_desc: Walk up to an apparatus and press E or click the action dock below. Press Space or Enter to execute operations.

wakeup.title: Lab waking up
wakeup.desc: Free hosting instances go to sleep when inactive. We are waking up the backend simulation engine. This usually takes 15–40 seconds.
wakeup.tip_default: In orbital mechanics, burning prograde raises the apoapsis on the opposite side of Earth, not where you ignite.

why_locked.title: 🔒 District Locked
why_locked.desc: This simulation district is part of the advanced curriculum progression.
why_locked.step1: Complete Foundation Safety & PPE protocols in Oral PK Ward
why_locked.step2: Master Acid-Base Neutralization & Equivalence in Chemistry Bench
why_locked.step3: Attain Grade B or higher on laboratory protocols to unlock advanced districts
